1.name: Tearoom Leisure
1.overview: You're alone with Chen Hai in the serene tea room. She gives you a lap pillow to ease your fatigue, and something special on top of that...
1.audition_text: Commander, I've reserved the tearoom for today. Why don't we use this opportunity to take a load off?

2.name: On the Beach With Kashino
2.overview:
"Do you like the beach, Commander? I really love it here."
Enjoy the sunshine and shimmering waves with Kashino.
Even the refreshing breeze and waves cannot cool her passion.
2.audition_text: Whew... That was fun! Heehee. I got a bit carried away. It's been quite a while since we played on the beach like this...

3.name: In the Infirmary With Janus
3.overview:
A girl's warmth right by your pillow
Her earnest desire to be by your side
comes to you as whispers by your bedside
3.audition_text: (Commander's scent... I wonder if it's okay for me to get a little closer...)

4.name: Sweetness that Melts in the Mouth
4.overview: Ice cream on a Ferris wheel is sweet, but this moment with New Jersey is many times sweeter.
4.audition_text: You can't ride a Ferris wheel and NOT kiss at the top♪ It'll be a memory you can cherish forever, honey♡

5.name: The Greatest Reward
5.overview: It's a dull afternoon. Emden has come, offering you a reward almost too good for a mere human.
5.audition_text: Relax, now. There is nothing you have to be embarrassed of.

6.name: A Gift From... Hammann?
6.audition_text: Anyway, that dummy sure is taking long... How long am I gonna have to wait here?
6.overview: Hammann tries to play a prank on you, only for it to backfire in your favor.

7.name: Your Desire is All Mine
7.audition_text: In return... you could take a bite out of me. Whatever part you like.
7.overview:
A tipsy moment with St. Louis. 
From her luscious lips, temptation flows forth...

8.name: Symphonious Heartbeats
8.overview: An earbud cord brings you and Helena closer and closer. Is that static noise you hear? No, it's a steady throb; the most precious thing...
8.audition_text: Just a little while longer. I want to stay immersed... in the harmony of our beating hearts...

9.name: Slightly Feverish Kitchen
9.audition_text: My, I can't tell what you're thinking at all, Commander. Shall we take a short break first? After all... the real deal is still ahead of us.
9.overview: Ting An, while showing off her cooking skills, also wants to offer some tips for making dim sum. In this hot and humid kitchen, the temperature between the two of you is also rising...

10.name: A Girl's Secret Plans
10.audition_text: Heehee... That's right. I might get sooo exhausted that I won't be able to move a muscle~
10.overview: San Jacinto invites you to give her swimming lessons. The girl's laughter, the splashing water... The two of you soon end up with time all to yourselves. Will her heart-throbbing plan come to fruition?

11.name: Intoxicated by Lingering Sounds
11.audition_text: Hm? You say you're... intoxicated by my voice? It's "as sweet as nectar"?
11.overview: You happen to run into Unzen while she is reading in the library.As the two of you read together, the atmosphere gradually becomes hazy to the sound of Unzen's voice–

12.name: Having Fun in Secret
12.audition_text: "Gotten more daring," you say? Heehee. Yes, because there's no one else around. Nobody else has to know, right?
12.overview: You and Hwah Jah are playing tag and stumble upon a surprising hiding place – a locker.

13.name: A Tipsy Summer Rendezvous
13.audition_text: Please, little one... Keep me company for the rest of the night.
13.overview: On a warm summer night, Friedrich Carl invites you to sip some wine and talk about love.

14.name: Caught in a Sweet Trap
14.audition_text: Hmm? You say you don't want it, but looks like your body does. Can't resist that smell, right?
14.overview: You were out treasure hunting and fell into a pit. Then, Royal Fortune appears before you and shows her true colors.

15.name: Shelter From the Rain
15.overview:
You and Yorktown seek shelter from the rain together.
Between her soaked, see-through clothes and the warmth of her skin, you pray this rain doesn't let up anytime soon.
15.audition_text: Close enough so you can reach me... Close enough so... I can hear your heartbeat.

16.name: Mary By Your Bed
16.audition_text: Don't worry, I'm not like the girl in the story. I'll always keep you close and love you forever, okay?
16.overview:
The tempestuous ghost ship pays a late-night visit to your bedroom.
For better or worse, she has a spine-chilling bedtime story for you.

17.name: The Secret to Becoming Close
17.audition_text: This must be fate. Fate brought us together and let us have such a blissful time together...
17.overview:
Voroshilov invites you to join her in the hot spring to deepen your bond with her.
However, not everything goes as she'd planned.

18.name: Christmas Surprise
18.audition_text: Mgh... You can pull a little harder, it's not hurting me...
18.overview:
It's Christmas Eve, and Bremerton is here to see you, but then bad luck strikes and she gets stuck in the window.
In order to free her, you might have to touch her in a few places...

19.name: The Dragon God's Gift of Udon
19.audition_text: You have to really dig your heels in... where the dough is still stiff... And if that's not enough... You do it again...
19.overview:
Shimanto challenged herself to make udon in the traditional Sakuran way for the New Year.
The dough can get quite slippery, and only you can help her correct a misstep.

20.name: Seaside Date With You
20.audition_text: If you're not satisfied with my mark, just lemme know, alright?
20.overview:
You and Harbin share a loving seaside date, with sunbathing and even a small water fight.
Come nightfall, the romance shall begin.

21.name: The Forbidden Midnight Confessional
21.audition_text: Heehee. I like people who catch my drift. They're my favourite people to do unspeakable things with♥
21.overview:
Moonlight shines through the stained glass windows as a lady dressed in nun's clothes await a lost lamb.
Does the night bring salvation or temptation within this confessional?

22.name: Sentiment Within the Sweetness
22.audition_text: Eep! Mmh... Commander, with all due respect, that was a little too sudden...
22.overview:
Hai Tien comes to the Commander's office with a bowl of tong sui. 
She makes a misstep and falls, which has some wet consequences...

23.name: Endurance Training in the Sauna
23.audition_text: I can't bear this anymore... This punishment is too much for me...
23.overview:
The Commander brings the heat-sensitive Mogador into a sauna to build up her tolerance. 
She has to withstand this steamy, hot, intense training for a reward...

24.name: "Cleaning" a Collection Piece
24.audition_text: Heheh. Look at you, still twitching so much. Aww, my cute little precious thing. If you're still feeling cold, why don't you come in for a big hug?
24.overview:
"Do you know how to keep your collection in good condition?"
That's Golden Hind's question to you. In the spirit of "show, don't tell," she provides a demonstration on her "most precious thing."

25.name: Another Day, Another Date!
25.audition_text: Ahh, so comfy... Don't just stand there, Commander! Hop into the bed with me!
25.overview:
It's been an awesome day for you and Z52, but now night has come.
She lies down in bed and wants you to join her...

26.name: Monster's Dietary Observation Log
26.audition_text: Are you not afraid of being devoured, my sweet...delicious...Commander?
26.overview:
You are worried after hearing that Fancy has been eating some strange things.
She makes you accompany her, and you end up learning more about her "feeding behaviors" than you bargained for...

27.name: A Mesmerizing Respite
27.audition_text: Now then, Commander...you have my full trust...
27.overview:
Where, oh where, can one find the ultimate relaxation spot that is comfortable, worry-free, and utterly irresistible?
The answer might just be found betwixt Musashi's gently-swaying tails.

28.name: Sweetest Slumber
28.audition_text: Let me stay by your side and whisper in your ear…
28.overview:
You fall asleep face-down on your desk, utterly exhausted. In a daze, you notice Duisburg approaching...
Before long, her sweet voice lulls you back into dreams.

29.name: Steamy Shower Encounter
29.overview: After a swim, I went to the showers to get washed off, only to hear someone's singing voice coming from within... It's too late to back out now!

30.name: Tonight's Checkup
30.audition_text: Oh my... You'd like to find the answer yourself, from my heartbeat?
30.overview:
<size=27>Due to the sheer stress of overwork, the Commander has missed a regularly-scheduled checkup at the port.
That night, as the Commander lies on the infirmary bed, about to perform a self-examination, Alvitr suddenly emerges from behind the curtains...</size>
